**Audiobind** - fix an audiobook library instead of curating it by hand.
Audiobind merges multi-part rips into a single m4b, verifies every book against the Audible catalog (title, author, narrator, series), proves completeness by comparing runtime with the catalog, then embeds real chapter marks, cover art and tags before filing the result as `Author/Title/Title.m4b`.
It is deliberately conservative: anything it is not confident about is marked for review rather than converted, and the source library is mounted read-only.
Support and bug reports: please use the support thread linked above.
